svg.aria-label: Constructed independent-scission model and a separate spherical surface-erosion model. Mean lengths in A are normalized to their initial value of 100; B shows mass by fragment-length class; C changes only the maximum soluble length; D changes only initial radius. The panels distinguish molecular, mass, solubility and geometry effects.
